model_output.verdict: An accountant with substantial experience and a clear accounts payable workload, with a few details still to fill in.
write_up: A recruiter can see your path from senior accounting in Vietnam to bookkeeping and accounts payable in Houston. Processing around 400 vendor invoices every month gives the current role a useful measure. The main question is what part of month-end closing is yours.

Your best line is the one about reducing month-end closing from 12 days to 7 days. It names both the change and the checklist and template you made. Use that as a model when you add detail to your current closing work and your earlier team management.
